verdict.rationale: Mesh screens customers against sanctions, watchlists, PEP registers and adverse media from one global database (docs-1). This runs through a single OAuth2 API with synchronous onboarding screening and AML-type hit output (docs-5, docs-8, docs-14). Cases and alerts can be reviewed and decided in one web app or via the API (docs-16, docs-21, docs-22). However, nothing in the evidence shows ComplyAdvantage performing the identity verification itself, so the 'same verification, one vendor' consolidation is unproven and a separate IDV vendor would likely be needed. Missing for 10: evidence of built-in identity/document verification bundled with screening in one flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
